us_policy.title: 🇺🇸 United States Policy
us_policy.content:
• **SEC Rule 10-C (AI Risk Disclosure):** The SEC issued a final rule requiring all publicly traded companies to disclose the percentage of revenue derived from generative AI and the specific risks posed by AI-driven automation to their workforce. Previously: Disclosure of AI integration was voluntary and qualitative. Now: Mandatory quarterly quantitative reporting on AI revenue dependency and risk thresholds, effective January 1, 2027. This increases transparency for AI-exposed equities but raises compliance overhead for mid-cap firms. Federal Register

• **Executive Order 14210 (Quantum-Resistant Encryption):** The President signed an EO mandating that all federal agencies and their third-party contractors migrate to post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards. Previously: Migration followed non-binding NIST guidance. Now: Legally mandated migration schedule with failure to comply resulting in the immediate suspension of federal contracts, effective immediately. This creates a guaranteed long-term demand cycle for specialized cybersecurity firms specializing in quantum-resistant architecture. Whitehouse.gov

• **Treasury OFAC Sanctions (Semiconductor Export Restrictions):** The Department of the Treasury designated three foreign semiconductor firms as Specially Designated Nationals (SDNs) for facilitating unauthorized military technology transfers. Previously: These firms were permitted to trade with US-based distributors. Now: Total asset freeze and a comprehensive prohibition on all transactions between US persons and these entities, effective immediately. This disrupts specific supply chains for high-end GPU components, potentially benefiting domestic semiconductor alternatives. US Treasury

• **Energy Independence Act of 2026:** The President signed into law legislation providing $15 billion in new tax credits for the deployment of Small Modular Reactors (SMRs). Previously: Federal tax credits were limited to utility-scale traditional nuclear plants. Now: SMRs are eligible for a 30% investment tax credit for projects reaching financial close by December 31, 2028, effective November 6, 2026. This accelerates capital expenditure and viability for advanced nuclear energy startups. Congress.gov

Why it matters: The simultaneous pivot toward mandated AI transparency and quantum-resistant security signals a regulatory shift from "innovation-first" to "stability-and-security-first" for the US tech sector.

portugal_policy.title: 🇵🇹 Portugal Policy & Law
portugal_policy.content:
No significant laws, decree-laws, or portarias with material impact were approved or entered into force between October 30 and November 6, 2026. The Assembleia da República is currently focused on the debate and voting of the 2027 State Budget (Orçamento do Estado para 2027), which will define the fiscal and regulatory framework for the next calendar year.

Why it matters: The imminent approval of the 2027 State Budget will be the most significant regulatory event for investors, determining new tax thresholds and social security adjustments.

eu_policy.title: 🇪🇺 European Union Policy
eu_policy.content:
• **AI Act (Delegated Regulation on High-Risk AI Categories):** Requires providers of AI systems used in critical infrastructure, education, or law enforcement to implement mandatory quality management systems and maintain exhaustive technical documentation. Previously: AI systems were governed by non-binding ethics guidelines. Now: High-risk AI systems must undergo mandatory conformity assessments and obtain CE marking before market entry. Compliance deadline is November 2026 for the listed categories; affects all AI developers and deployers. Particularly relevant for Portuguese tech hubs developing gov-tech and administrative solutions. EUR-Lex

• **CSRD (Reporting Standard for Large Undertakings):** Mandates that all large companies meeting at least two of three criteria—over 250 employees, €50m annual turnover, or €25m total assets—publish audited sustainability reports according to ESRS standards. Previously: The NFRD only required reporting for public-interest entities with >500 employees. Now: Mandatory reporting is expanded to all large undertakings with >250 employees. Reports on 2025 data must be published by 2026; affects large EU businesses and their auditors. High impact on Portuguese mid-cap companies expanding operations. EUR-Lex

• **MiCA (RTS on Liquidity Reserves for Asset-Referenced Tokens):** Obliges issuers of asset-referenced tokens (ARTs) to maintain a specific liquidity buffer to ensure redemption rights for holders. Previously: No harmonized EU-wide reserve requirements existed for asset-referenced tokens. Now: Issuers must maintain a minimum liquidity buffer of 30% of the reserve assets in highly liquid instruments. Application begins immediately upon publication in the Official Journal; affects stablecoin issuers and crypto-asset service providers (CASPs). Impacts Portuguese fintech investors and digital asset custodians. Official Journal of the EU

Why it matters: The simultaneous enforcement of high-risk AI requirements and expanded sustainability reporting marks a transition from voluntary frameworks to strict, quantifiable compliance for the EU's digital and green economies.

Transcription / Audio | None | OpenAI Whisper | Otter.ai | Free (OS) | Low | Not using | Whisper provides professional-grade transcription for free.
Task Automation | Claude.ai | Make.com | Zapier | Free tier | Medium | Upgrade | Actual agentic automation requires Make.com's API orchestration over a chat interface.

Takeaway: With no major releases today, the most actionable move is filling your stack's gaps by adopting Whisper for audio and Make.com for true workflow automation.
